# vercel_api_key (Resource)

Provides an API Key resource.

An API Key can be used to authenticate with the Vercel AI Gateway.

The `api_key_string` value is only returned during creation and is stored (marked sensitive) in Terraform state. It cannot be retrieved again later, so imported resources will not populate `api_key_string`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vercel_api_key" "ai_gateway" {
  name    = "workflow-github-actions"
  purpose = "ai-gateway"
}

output "ai_gateway_api_key" {
  value     = vercel_api_key.ai_gateway.api_key_string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The human-readable name of the API key.
- `purpose` (String) The purpose of the API key. Currently, only `ai-gateway` is supported.

### Optional

- `team_id` (String) The ID of the Vercel team scope for this API key. Required if a default team has not been set in the provider.

### Read-Only

- `api_key_string` (String, Sensitive) The API key value. This is only returned during creation and then preserved in Terraform state.
- `created_at` (Number) The Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the API key was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the API key.
- `partial_key` (String) The final characters of the API key, used for identification.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# API keys can be imported by team and API key ID.
terraform import vercel_api_key.ai_gateway team_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx/key_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

# Or when a default team is configured on the provider, by API key ID only.
terraform import vercel_api_key.ai_gateway key_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```
